_comment: Copy this file to restore-config.json (gitignored) and edit for your install.
Every section is optional - delete what you do not want restored.
Credentials are stored in plaintext here, exactly as ashita.ini stores them;
keep the file mode at 600 and do not commit it.
"$STEAM_LIBRARY/...". It can also be omitted entirely, in which case the
HXI_GAME_DIR environment variable is used, then the stock Faugus default
shown below. The --game-dir flag overrides all of them.
pivot_root_path is a path INSIDE the Wine prefix (a C:\ path as the game
sees it), so it does not change between machines unless you installed the
game somewhere other than C:\Program Files\HorizonXI.
